capabilities: Insert HTML checkboxes via a command or the editor menu
Make HTML checkboxes clickable in notes and embedded views
Fix duplicated checkbox IDs after pasting or on demand
Switch between alternate checkbox styles from a right-click menu
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only inserts standalone clickable HTML checkboxes into note text.
extras: The README warns not to edit checkboxes manually, not to remove their unique IDs, and notes that clicking checkboxes in embedded views may cause blinking in canvas. Alternate checkbox styles need a theme or custom CSS to look different.
motivation: The author explains that HTML checkboxes are useful because they can be put into Markdown tables and placed anywhere in a note.
problem: Markdown task checkboxes cannot be placed inside tables or several per line, limiting where checkable items can be used.
summary: Adds clickable HTML checkboxes to notes via a command, so they can be placed inside Markdown tables or inline in a row.
